newsitem.title: JAPAN: Bankers Trust tie-up to help NCB restructure--MOF.
newsitem.headline: Bankers Trust tie-up to help NCB restructure--MOF.

text.p: Nippon Credit Bank's planned business tie-up with Bankers Trust New York Corp will contribute to NCB's restructuring efforts, Vice Finance Minister Tadashi Ogawa said on Thursday.
He said the planned alliance will be received favourably by Japanese financial institutions involved in NCB's restructuring plan.
"These (tie-up) movements will be a big plus when those institutions evaluate the restructuring plan," Ogawa said.

Ogawa said that it was his understanding that NCB had disposed of all the bad loans that it could have at this time, based on the bank's own assessment of its financial conditions and third-party checks.
The ministry does not simply receive reports of banks' own inspections of their finances, but also checks the basic methods in which they calculate their finances, Ogawa said.
